title: Memo-Labour- Min Pao And Other Local Newspapers - The Inspection Of Factories

page_data.en:
April 11, 1933.

LABOUR

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

THE INSPECTION OF FACTORIES.

The Social Bureau is conducting an inspection
of factories in Chinese controlled territory. As regards
the factories in the International Settlement, the S.M.C.
desires to make its own inspection. In view of the fact
that such inspection of factories by the Settlement authorities
is an infringement of China's sovereign rights

the Chinese authorities' detailed deputies to discuss with
the S.M.C. the question of inspection because the Settlement
authorities have no authority to undertake this inspection.
So far no satisfactory result has been attained.

On April 10, the Secretariat of the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai sent the following letter to the Chinese
Ratepayers Association in the International Settlement:-
"The Secretariat has received a letter from the
Mayor of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai bearing on the
proposal of the Settlement authorities to call a special
meeting of foreign ratepayers to discuss an amendment to
Article 34 of the Appendix of the Yang King Pang Land
Regulations with the object of enabling the Council to
control factories in the International Settlement.
"The object of the Factory Law is to improve the
condition of labourers and also to promote the good relations
between employers and employees. If the inspection of
factories in the International Settlement, where two-thirds
of the factories in Shanghai are located, can not be carried
out at the same time as the factory inspection in Chinese
controlled territory, it will constitute an obstruction to
the inspection of factories in the whole district and will
cause factories outside the Settlement to oppose the
inspection on the ground that the factories in the Settlement
are not being inspected. Despite the negotiations conducted
by our deputies with the S.M.C., no satisfactory result has
been reached. Since the Council can not define the labour
rules and order the ratepayers in the Settlement to observe
them (Mr. Wright, Legal Advisor of the Council, stated the
above in 1925), it is endeavouring to secure legal support
to enable it to control factories in the Settlement by
amending the Yang King Pang Regulations.
"It must not be overlooked that the inspection
of factories is for the purpose of enforcing the Chinese
labour policy and its aim is to lead to the complete
development of Chinese industry. The inspection is not an
administrative act. The Council is not entitled to resort
to the stipulations contained in Article 9 of the Yang King
Pang Regulations and to devise means to seize the authority
to inspect factories. The territorial rights over the
Settlement still belong to China and the Chinese residents
in the Settlement are naturally still under the control of
the Chinese Government in the same way as are the people
living outside the Settlement.
"In order to secure an early enforcement of the
inspection of factories in the Settlement, we are willing
to open sincere negotiations with the S.M.C."

（右上角框内文字：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. B. REGISTRY. / No. D 2337 / Date 11 / 4 / 33 / Morning Translation）

1933年4月11日。

劳工

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

工厂视察。

社会局正在对华界境内的工厂进行视察。至于公共租界内的工厂，工部局希望自行进行视察。鉴于租界当局此类工厂视察行为侵犯了中国的主权权利，

中方已委派详细代表与工部局商讨视察事宜，因为租界当局无权进行此项视察。迄今尚未取得满意结果。

4月10日，大上海市政府秘书处致函公共租界华人纳税会，信函内容如下：“秘书处收到大上海市长来函，涉及租界当局提议召开外国纳税人特别会议，讨论修订《洋泾浜土地章程》附录第34条，旨在使工部局能够管制公共租界内的工厂。
“《工厂法》的宗旨在于改善劳工状况，并促进雇主与雇员之间的良好关系。如果上海三分之二工厂所在的公共租界内的工厂视察工作，不能与华界境内的工厂视察同步进行，这将构成对整个地区工厂视察工作的阻碍，并导致租界外的工厂以租界内工厂未受视察为由反对视察。尽管我方代表已与工部局进行谈判，但仍未达成满意结果。既然工部局无法制定劳工规则并命令租界内的纳税人遵守（工部局法律顾问赖特先生曾于1925年发表上述言论），它正试图通过修订《洋泾浜章程》以获得法律支持，从而使其能够管制租界内的工厂。
“不可忽视的是，工厂视察的目的是为了执行中国的劳工政策，其目标在于引导中国工业的全面发展。视察并非行政行为。工部局无权援引《洋泾浜章程》第9条之规定，并 devise 手段以攫取工厂视察权。租界的领土主权仍属于中国，租界内的中国居民自然仍受中国政府管辖，这与居住在租界以外的人们一样。
“为确保租界内工厂视察工作早日实施，我们愿与工部局展开真诚谈判。”

（右上角框内文字：上海公共租界警务处 / 刑事与特别股登记处 / 编号 D 2337 / 日期 1933年4月11日 / 晨间译件）
